narrative: After the 33-action level-1 prefix, the rendered 16x16 movement lattice showed the solid carrier at (6,9), its direction cursor at (3,2), outlined blocks at (10,5), (12,6), (9,7), (12,8), and (11,10), and the 2x3 receiving bay at x=3..4, y=7..9. An offline exhaustive search over all 120 block orders and every distinct assignment of five blocks to five of the six bay cells found an optimistic minimum of 80 movement actions, with ACTION5 pickup/drop charged as zero; this exceeds the 64-cell budget by 16 before any steering-inertia overhead. Per the required decision rule I stopped without executing that infeasible route, so levels_completed remained 1 and there was no winning sequence to submit to reproduce().
